about: Per-entity fade state for render view 1, one of the ~13 ecl::*FadeView0/1 sources that bg3.exe+0x18E1E00 handles side by side (it removes the component for entities no longer in its source list). Never alive in the captures; layout from the Windows creator only.

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 (only rx3 user; ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(.., 0x14)) writes 0 as a 4-byte store (*puVar4 = 0); meaning from the identical creator/system pair of the Timeline sibling (bg3.exe+0x18F6530 / 0x18EB2D0).
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 writes 0x40800000 = 4.0 (puVar4[1]). Probably the fade speed, as in the Timeline sibling; no reader found.
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 writes 0 with one 16-bit store covering +8/+9; the Timeline sibling's system copies byte 8 of the request here and, when set, writes TargetValue into CurrentValue at once.
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10: second byte of the 16-bit zero store at +8; byte-wide in the Timeline sibling's request copy.
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 writes 1 as a byte at +10.
not written by bg3.exe+0x18F4E10; padding before the float at +0xC (live garbage in the siblings)
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 writes 0x3f800000 = 1.0 (puVar4[3]); meaning from the Timeline sibling.
bg3.exe+0x18F4E10 writes 1 as a byte at +0x10; meaning from the Timeline sibling.
tail padding to the registry size 20 (alignment 4)
